title: The Stars with Rhonda: The Enemy Is in the Building
description: Rhonda reads the stars. Every sign has a nemesis, and the nemesis is already inside. Ronnie tries to find the exit.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And now, the stars. <p:0.3> With Rhonda.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Good evening. Tonight, every sign has an enemy. <p:0.3> And the enemy is already in the building.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: [question-en] In the... which building? My building?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Taurus. The coworker who took the last good chair has begun a campaign against you. It will end one of you.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Over a chair? Surely you mean, like, professionally.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: I mean as I have said it. Cancer. You brought a casserole to the potluck. So did your rival. <p:0.3> Only one dish comes home empty.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: A casserole standoff, that I can root for. <p:0.3> Wait, who's the enemy in MY building? You never said.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Leo. Your foe sits closer than you think. They host a small show. They ask too many questions.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That's... <p:0.3> that's just a description of me. Rhonda. Rhonda, am I the enemy in the building?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: The stars don't name names, Ronnie. <p:0.3> They just unlock the studio door.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It locks from the INSIDE! <p:0.3> We'll be right back. If I'm back.
